title: Reference local-gradient state-sufficiency diagnostic
question: Does the existing reduced state (H, Wb, Wt) retain enough information to make the local lower-profile gradient geometry approximately single-valued across opposite water-table motion directions, or does direction/history carry additional information?

reduced_state.distance: Euclidean distance in the three fixed physically normalized coordinates.

hidden_reference_geometry.source: A2 full-order Reference profile only; never added to reduced state.
hidden_reference_geometry.point_authority: Use the already-supported B4 point-head distances. For d=2.5 cm use capillary head at x=d and x=2d = 5 cm above the water table. For d=5 cm use x=d and x=2d = 10 cm.

pairing.cross_direction: For every RISE endpoint choose the nearest FALL endpoint by reduced-state distance and for every FALL endpoint choose the nearest RISE endpoint; deduplicate identical unordered pairs.
pairing.within_direction_control_pool: All distinct endpoint pairs within RISE plus all distinct endpoint pairs within FALL. Selection uses reduced state only.
pairing.distance_matching: For each cross-direction pair, choose the within-direction control pair whose reduced-state distance is nearest to the cross-pair distance, using sorted distance and deterministic lower-index tie break. Controls may be reused.

outputs: cross-direction and matched-control reduced-state distance distributions
absolute differences in s_terminal, s_bulk_adjacent and curvature_proxy
fraction of cross-direction pairs whose hidden-geometry difference exceeds its distance-matched within-direction control
median and p90 hidden-geometry differences for cross-direction and matched controls
closest 32 cross-direction pairs by state distance with full diagnostics
direction-conditioned means and ranges of curvature_proxy

decision_rule.DIRECTION_HISTORY_INFORMATION_SUPPORTED: For both widths, cross-direction pairs have strictly larger median hidden-geometry difference than matched controls for s_terminal and curvature_proxy, and more than 50% of pairs exceed matched controls for both quantities.
decision_rule.CURRENT_STATE_NOT_SHOWN_INSUFFICIENT: Complete diagnostic but the above rule is not met for both widths.
decision_rule.C4K_DIAGNOSTIC_BLOCKED: Reference point extraction, state construction or pairing cannot be completed.

interpretation_boundary: Support means direction/history contains information about local gradient geometry not well captured by closeness in the current (H,Wb,Wt) state under this A2 laboratory.
Support does not by itself choose a new prognostic state, Hdot-dependent closure, direction switch or memory model.
Failure to support does not prove universal sufficiency outside the tested laboratory.
